context: Accessible hive plot data visualization showing 80 nodes on 3 structural axes (Sources, Connectors, Sinks) with ~120 curved edges, featuring full keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
first_impression: A polished, accessibility-first hive plot with a deliberately chosen colorblind-safe palette, clean typographic hierarchy in the side panel, and confident whitespace — feels designed rather than defaulted.
what_works: The Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette (#4477AA, #EE6677, #228833) is an intentional and harmonious choice that goes well beyond schemeCategory10; the side panel has genuine typographic hierarchy with uppercase legend headers, weighted node names, and muted secondary text creating clear visual entry points.
what_doesnt: Node density along each axis packs circles so tightly that individual nodes are nearly indistinguishable without hovering — the linear axis layout creates visual clumping that undermines readability at a glance; the mass of ~140 edge curves converging near the center creates a visually noisy core that obscures the structural patterns the hive plot is meant to reveal.
